ref_to_cand.proof:
fun {R} [CommRing R] a h x =>
  (fun {R} [Ring R] a x h =>
      Eq.symm
        (Eq.mp
          (forall_congr fun {R} =>
            forall_congr fun [Ring R] =>
              forall_congr fun a =>
                forall_congr fun x =>
                  implies_congr (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (pow_two a)) 0)
                    (Eq.refl (a * (a * x + x * a) = (a * x + x * a) * a)))
          (@SemantEqRef.exercise_4_2_6) a x h))
    a x h
